tests03's normalized phrasing relation must preserve above/below distinction while identifying agent renamings; load_txt reset is literal '1', not numeric equivalence. StepGame score ties map to left, so replacing missing model weights with abstention changes graph answers. bAbI relation adjacency uses subtraction, unlike StepGame's directly signed reciprocal graph; an adapter that copies edge orientation would invert displacement. Command parser errors happen before apply in fixtures; bAbI read increments t before parser failure and is not transactional. CLI configuration checks cannot establish legacy school failure/publication semantics.
inverse: Exclude a composed StepGame answer when query agent count is not two or target unreachable; exclude lexical certainty for clock/conflicting-axis phrases. Exclude replacing known Story speaker and dropping another holder. In selected command fixtures exclude grammar acceptance of listed malformed commands, observed rollback growth, claim/dream changes to canonical observations and invented total temporal order. Exclude explicitly configured state/prag flags in child helpers. Do not exclude bAbI pre-error t increments, contradictory first-path graphs, or unexecuted legacy CLI side effects.

StepGame label preimage consists of all Reader/Item graphs with first-path displacement in its sign orthant; phrasing and load discard agent names/support/numbering. bAbI exact holder-map output admits all histories with identical final holder domains and equal last surviving ownership on every target key; an empty target requires empty final ownership, and state_lines omits speaker/attributes. Passing command assertions determines only observed projections and finite fixtures. Equal canonical world cannot reconstruct differing claims/dreams. Configured Command recovers explicit model/mode/path inputs but not ambient env or eventual subprocess effects.
limitations: Seven registered sources are partial models, not complete proofs
